## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- Pull request #116 adds `Fanfiction Discovery Starter` with three first-party destinations: FanFiction.Net story/crossover search, Fimfiction story browse, and Scribble Hub's Fanfiction genre. The admitted capability is static link-only. WebNR stores destination URLs plus WebNR-authored descriptions/labels; it does not crawl, poll, proxy, mirror, download, or copy origin story metadata, covers, ratings, comments, accounts, or story text and does not use Fimfiction API credentials or background API calls.
- The 2026-08-25 source program screened five candidate families: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub Fanfiction, Archive of Our Own (AO3), and Twisting the Hellmouth. FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, and Scribble Hub received complete review for static link-only admission and shipped in #116. AO3 remains deferred until sufficiently current first-party machine-access/policy evidence is available; Twisting the Hellmouth remains deferred because its first-party reader surface was not reliably accessible from the operating environment. Rotating health checks revalidated the maintained SpaceBattles Discover Stories, Sufficient Velocity Story Library, and Top Web Fiction discovery surfaces.
- Pull request #114 remains the latest substantial reader asset. Its 2026-08-24 Progression Fantasy/LitRPG recommendation-method guide contains more than 10,000 Chinese main-text characters, 22 academic references plus 24 platform/community/first-party sources, multiple fresh public-web research rounds, current Royal Road and community evidence, counterexamples/boundaries, a six-dimensional demand-vector method, a four-layer evidence chain, and an original four-factor recommendation-confidence synthesis. The next scheduled substantial asset is the 2026-08-26 fanfiction / transformative-serial-fiction discovery guide; no cadence-only filler was published on 2026-08-25 because the 2026-08-24 guide remained inside the rolling 48-hour window.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter, and Fanfiction Discovery Starter. Rights/access behavior remains source-specific; several maintained catalogs are intentionally link-only.
- The deferred source queue includes Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, Baen Free Library, LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, Laterpress, Fanqie / 番茄小说, Changpei / 长佩文学, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说, 刺猬猫, ハーメルン, Nolaノベル, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, pixiv novels, 카카오페이지 / KakaoPage, 조아라 / Joara, OneStory, Bookcube, MrBlue, Ascendant Reads, ProgFans, Royal Guard Publishing, The Legion Publishers, Archive of Our Own (AO3), and Twisting the Hellmouth.
